title: PLUGH: A Benchmark for Spatial Understanding and Reasoning in Large Language Models

live_model.evidence: Table 2: 'gpt-4-turbo 66.8% 70.7% 70.8% 71.4%' (edges F1, 0/1/2/3-shot); Sec. 3.6: 'with temperature 0.01 (since some of the models deny usage of zero temperature)'

prompt.location: Sec. 3.1 'Task Description' block (instruction text for Task 1); exact prompt and few-shot format in the repo
prompt.note: Appendix A prints only the GPT-4 data-conversion prompt used to build the benchmark.

claim.metric: edges retrieval F1, Task 1 Graph Reconstruction, 0-shot

data.source: PLUGH benchmark and code, https://github.com/altsoph/PLUGH (5 tasks x 125 texts with ground-truth graphs)

notes: Paper dated 2024-08-03 with no preview string, so 'gpt-4-turbo' resolves to the 2024-04-09 GA. Fuzzy node matching and graphviz parsing from the repo are needed for scoring; the task description reads like the prompt but is not labelled as verbatim.

resolution.plan: Sec. 3.1 prints the Task 1 instruction block but not the exact 0-shot prompt layout; take the prompt, the 125 fiction texts, the ground-truth graphs and the flexible graphviz parser plus fuzzy matcher (lowercasing, article/preposition stripping, substring equality) from the repository. Run gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0.01 once per text, parse the returned graph and compute edges-retrieval F1; compare with 66.8 (Table 2; Table 8 reports 67.4 for the fuzzy 0-shot metric).
resolution.approximation: If the repository prompt differs from the Sec. 3.1 block, the repository version is used; the parser and fuzzy matching must be the repository's to reproduce the metric.
